facts.text: SpheroNode is an rclpy Node subclass constructed with the node name "sphero".

_init_pubsub creates the odom, imu, collision and /diagnostics publishers and the cmd_vel, set_color, set_back_led, disable_stabilization, set_heading and set_angular_velocity subscriptions; it creates no ROS service or action.
The odom publisher is nav_msgs/Odometry and is registered on the relative name "odom".
The imu publisher is sensor_msgs/Imu and is registered on the relative name "imu".
The collision publisher is sphero_msgs/SpheroCollision and is registered on the relative name "collision".
The /diagnostics publisher is diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticArray.
The cmd_vel subscriber is geometry_msgs/Twist and is registered on the relative name "cmd_vel".
The set_color subscriber is std_msgs/ColorRGBA and is registered on the relative name "set_color".
The set_back_led subscriber is std_msgs/Float32 and is registered on the relative name "set_back_led".
The disable_stabilization subscriber is std_msgs/Bool and is registered on the relative name "disable_stabilization".
The set_heading subscriber is std_msgs/Float32 and is registered on the relative name "set_heading".
The set_angular_velocity subscriber is std_msgs/Float32 and is registered on the relative name "set_angular_velocity".

The cmd_vel callback sets heading to normalize_angle_positive(atan2(linear.x, linear.y)) in degrees and speed to hypot(linear.x, linear.y), truncates both with int(), and calls robot.roll(speed, heading, 1, False); it ignores twist.angular.z and publishes no motion acknowledgement.
The cmd_vel timeout is set to 0.6 s.
The timer callback rolls zero when the cmd_vel timeout has elapsed and the last commanded heading or speed was nonzero, then publishes diagnostics once per second.
The only stop() method is the node shutdown path: it rolls zero, sets shutdown, sleeps one second, disconnects and joins; it is not registered as a ROS service or action.
The set_color callback multiplies ColorRGBA r, g and b by 255 and passes the truncated values to set_rgb_led with save=0.
The set_back_led callback passes Float32 data unchanged to robot.set_back(data, False).
The set_stabilization callback passes 1 to set_stablization when the Bool is false and 0 when it is true.
The set_heading callback normalizes Float32 radians, converts to whole degrees and calls set_heading.
The set_angular_velocity callback converts Float32 radians per second to int((value*180/pi)/0.784) and calls set_rotation_rate.
The native roll command documents speed 0..255 and heading 0..359 degrees and clamps speed to 0..255 before packing.
The native set_rgb_led command clamps red, green and blue each to 0..255 before packing.
The native set_back_led command documents brightness 0..255 and clamps it to 0..255.
The native set_heading command documents a heading range of 0..359 degrees.
The native set_stablization command documents 00h for off and 01h for on.
The native set_rotation_rate command documents units of 0.784 degrees/s, 255 as the maximum and 1 as the minimum, and clamps the rate to 0..255.
SpheroCollision declares one std_msgs/Header and eight int32 fields (x, y, z, axis, x_magnitude, y_magnitude, speed, timestamp) with no unit annotations.

safe_state.description: No acknowledged ROS stop exists: the node offers only a zero cmd_vel publication, a 0.6 s no-command roll(0,0) timer and a shutdown-only stop() method, none of which is a ROS-accessible acknowledged safe state or an independent hardware e-stop.
